title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 24 V, Vout = 5 V, Iout = 15 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 5.61 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0036 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 57 ns; gate charge Qg = 52 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.43 C/W, RthCS = 0.44 C/W, Ta = 40 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.005 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0121 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 13.7 uH, output capacitor C = 330 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 3.75 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 100 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 115 C; eta >= 96.5%; fan noise <= 40 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 35 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 15.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 12.9 / 6.45 / 4.51 / 3.22 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 2.18
  HS-2: Rsa = 8.6 / 4.3 / 3.01 / 2.15 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 3.68
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.91 / 2.79 / 1.94 / 1.4 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.91
  HS-4: Rsa = 4.08 / 1.94 / 1.34 / 0.97 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 11.00
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.79 / 1.29 / 0.91 / 0.64 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 16.56
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.94 / 0.91 / 0.64 / 0.48 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 28.71

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 32.2], [8.1, 19.3], [12.9, 9.7], [16.1, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.94
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 48.4], [21.5, 29.0], [34.4, 14.5], [43.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.22
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 43.0], [37.6, 25.8], [60.2, 12.9], [75.2, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 8.16
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 96.8], [59.1, 58.0], [94.6, 29.0], [118.2, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 13.44
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 118.2], [86.0, 71.0], [137.6, 35.5], [172.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 19.38

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
